fact: The World Bank status report says Component 2 of the Sierra Leone Land Administration Project will start new procurements to fast-track digitization of land records and development of a digital land information system, with the system development consultancy to be advertised in April 2024.
Sierra Leone's Chief Minister said in April 2025 that the lands ministry anticipates the launch of a land management information system, under the Sierra Leone Land Administration Project.

The World Bank's October 2024 status report says procurement is ongoing for a digital land information system for Sierra Leone's Ministry of Lands, with the contract tender still open and no transactions yet registered in it.
system: Land information system (Land Administration Project P177031)
